> So you advocate we "patch" the current widget to pass the issues

Yes I would like to be able to answer the instant search demo need. And for this demo it seems that the `id=` is not needed.

I would prefer us to answer theses implementations and only them before thinking of more API needs.

Then when we start integrating more deeply maybe we will need to draft and then rewrite the widgets for them to provide `htmlAttributes:{root, item}` but maybe not.
